title: MAINTENANCE SHOP TOWEL LAUNDRY SERVICE
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.NATIONAL GUARD BUREAU.JFHQ USPFO MI.USPFO MI PROCUREMENT.W7NF USPFO ACTIVITY MI ARNG
detail_text: 1.1 The Michigan National Guard is identifying potential businesses who can meet the requirements in the PWS for towel laundering service. The contractor shall 1.1.1 have an established route, equipment and logistic experience 1.1.2 deliver, pick up and transport items using conventional methods and comply with all local, state and federal sanitation and HAZMAT regulations 1.1.3 travel to 11 maintenance shops throughout Michigan twice a month 1.1.4 launder soiled maintenance shop rags/towels to remove dirt, grease, other petroleum, oil and lubricant products so they can be cleaned and in reusable condition 1.2 NAICS: 812332 Industrial Launderers. 1.3 PSC: S209 Housekeeping – Laundry/Drycleaning 1.4 It is anticipated to award a firm fixed price contract 1.4.1 Period of performance: 1 June 2026 – 31 May 2031 1.4.2 base and option periods are 12 months each 1.5 Requirement details are in Attachment A - Requirements 2.0 INFORMATION REQUESTED Please provide the following information: 2.1 Company name and address as appears on sam.gov entity information UEI and CAGE codes from sam.gov Socio economic SBA certification (i.e. small business, SDVOSB, WOSB) Point of contact information (name, email and phone number) 2.2 Explanation of how the requirements can be met 2.3 Summary of qualifications and experience with similar projects 2.4 Pricing will be requested in a formal Request for Quote and shall not be included in the submission for information. 3.0 SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS 3.1 Submit information electronically in PDF format 3.2 Information document shall not contain citations or active links to internet pages 3.3 Questions due: 16 March 2026, 12:30 pm Eastern Standard Time (EST) 3.3.1 Questions must be submitted via email to bonnie.l.reineer.civ@army.mil 3.4 Deadline Date: 27 March 2026 – 12:30 p.m. Eastern Standard Time (EST) 3.5 Email the information to bonnie.l.reineer.civ@army.mil and ng.mi.miarng.mbx.uspfo-pc-vendors@army.mil
